# KeyForge

> KeyForge (keyforge.win) is a Roblox and Luau script authentication, access-management, and protection platform.

Official site: https://www.keyforge.win
This GitHub repository is documentation only. It does not contain KeyForge source code.

KeyForge is not the fantasy card game that also uses the name KeyForge.

## Product

- Free Roblox key system: https://www.keyforge.win/roblox-key-system
- Free Luau / wYnFuscate obfuscator workflow: https://www.keyforge.win/free-luau-obfuscator
- Script protection: https://www.keyforge.win/lua-script-protection
- Luarmor alternative: https://www.keyforge.win/luarmor-alternative
- Panda Auth alternative: https://www.keyforge.win/panda-auth-alternative
- About: https://www.keyforge.win/about
- Docs: https://www.keyforge.win/docs
- Custom Lua GUI SDK: https://www.keyforge.win/docs/custom-lua-gui
- Tools: https://www.keyforge.win/tools

## How it works (public)

1. Owner creates a project, pastes Luau, picks protection, saves.
2. Owner generates a key (Discord and ad panels are optional).
3. Users run a loader: `_G.script_key` plus `HttpGet` to `https://www.keyforge.win/v1/load/{projectId}`.
4. KeyForge checks the key on the server (expiry, revoke, optional HWID) and delivers a protected payload.
5. Custom GUIs (Creator/Scale/Enterprise) call `getKeyUrl`, `verify`, and `loadScript` after downloading https://www.keyforge.win/sdk/client.lua

Obfuscation slows casual reading. It is not a license and does not make dumps impossible.
